name: GlobalEventID
description: Globally unique numeric identifier for this event record. Do not use the ID as the event chronology.

name: Day
description: Date on which the event occurred, encoded as YYYYMMDD.

name: MonthYear
description: Event date encoded as YYYYMM.

name: Year
description: Four digit year of the event.

name: FractionDate
description: Approximate event date represented as YYYY.FFFF, where the fractional component estimates how far into the year the event occurred.

name: Actor1Code
description: Complete CAMEO actor code, combining geographic, role, ethnicity, religion, and other classifications.

name: Actor1Name
description: Recognized name of actor 1, such as a person, organization, country, or actor class.

name: Actor1CountryCode
description: Three character CAMEO country affiliation code for actor 1.

name: Actor1KnownGroupCode
description: CAMEO code for a recognized international organization, nongovernmental organization, rebel group, or similar group.

name: Actor1EthnicCode
description: CAMEO ethnic affiliation code for actor 1, when identified.

name: Actor1Religion1Code
description: Primary CAMEO religious affiliation code for actor 1.

name: Actor1Religion2Code
description: Secondary CAMEO religious affiliation code for actor 1, if applicable.

name: Actor1Type1Code
description: Primary CAMEO role or type classification of actor 1, such as government, military, or opposition.

name: Actor1Type2Code
description: Second CAMEO role or type classification of actor 1.

name: Actor1Type3Code
description: Third CAMEO role or type classification of actor 1.

name: Actor2Code
description: Complete CAMEO actor code, combining geographic, role, ethnicity, religion, and other classifications.

name: Actor2Name
description: Recognized name of actor 2, such as a person, organization, country, or actor class.

name: Actor2CountryCode
description: Three character CAMEO country affiliation code for actor 2.

name: Actor2KnownGroupCode
description: CAMEO code for a recognized international organization, nongovernmental organization, rebel group, or similar group.

name: Actor2EthnicCode
description: CAMEO ethnic affiliation code for actor 2, when identified.

name: Actor2Religion1Code
description: Primary CAMEO religious affiliation code for actor 2.

name: Actor2Religion2Code
description: Secondary CAMEO religious affiliation code for actor 2, if applicable.

name: Actor2Type1Code
description: Primary CAMEO role or type classification of actor 2, such as government, military, or opposition.

name: Actor2Type2Code
description: Second CAMEO role or type classification of actor 2.

name: Actor2Type3Code
description: Third CAMEO role or type classification of actor 2.

name: IsRootEvent
description: Flag indicating whether the event appears in the lead portion of the initial source document; used as a rough prominence indicator.

name: EventCode
description: Raw CAMEO action code describing the action performed by Actor1 on Actor2. Stored as text to preserve leading zeros.

name: EventBaseCode
description: Level two parent action category in the CAMEO hierarchy. Preserve leading zeros.

name: EventRootCode
description: Top level CAMEO action category code. Preserve leading zeros.

name: QuadClass
description: CAMEO action class: 1 verbal cooperation; 2 material cooperation; 3 verbal conflict; 4 material conflict.

name: GoldsteinScale
description: Goldstein score assigned to the event action category, from negative ten to positive ten, estimating its theoretical effect on stability.

name: NumMentions
description: Total detected mentions of the event during the fifteen minute update in which it was first found; this legacy measure is not continuously updated.

name: NumSources
description: Number of distinct information sources reporting the event in the first fifteen minute update.

name: NumArticles
description: Number of source documents mentioning the event in the first fifteen minute update.

name: AvgTone
description: Average tone of documents mentioning the event in its initial update, from negative one hundred to positive one hundred.

name: Actor1Geo_Type
description: Geographic match specificity: 1 country, 2 US state, 3 US city, 4 world city, 5 world administrative division. Applies to Actor1.

name: Actor1Geo_Fullname
description: Human readable place name extracted from news text; spellings may vary across documents. Applies to Actor1.

name: Actor1Geo_CountryCode
description: Two character FIPS country code identifying the matched geographic place. Applies to Actor1.

name: Actor1Geo_ADM1Code
description: First level administrative division code associated with the matched place. Applies to Actor1.

name: Actor1Geo_ADM2Code
description: Second level administrative division code, where available. Applies to Actor1.

name: Actor1Geo_Lat
description: Latitude of the matched geographic feature or administrative area centroid. Applies to Actor1.

name: Actor1Geo_Long
description: Longitude of the matched geographic feature or administrative area centroid. Applies to Actor1.

name: Actor1Geo_FeatureID
description: GNS or GNIS feature identifier, or textual geographic code, for the matched place. Applies to Actor1.

name: Actor2Geo_Type
description: Geographic match specificity: 1 country, 2 US state, 3 US city, 4 world city, 5 world administrative division. Applies to Actor2.

name: Actor2Geo_Fullname
description: Human readable place name extracted from news text; spellings may vary across documents. Applies to Actor2.

name: Actor2Geo_CountryCode
description: Two character FIPS country code identifying the matched geographic place. Applies to Actor2.

name: Actor2Geo_ADM1Code
description: First level administrative division code associated with the matched place. Applies to Actor2.

name: Actor2Geo_ADM2Code
description: Second level administrative division code, where available. Applies to Actor2.

name: Actor2Geo_Lat
description: Latitude of the matched geographic feature or administrative area centroid. Applies to Actor2.

name: Actor2Geo_Long
description: Longitude of the matched geographic feature or administrative area centroid. Applies to Actor2.

name: Actor2Geo_FeatureID
description: GNS or GNIS feature identifier, or textual geographic code, for the matched place. Applies to Actor2.

name: ActionGeo_Type
description: Geographic match specificity: 1 country, 2 US state, 3 US city, 4 world city, 5 world administrative division. Applies to event action.

name: ActionGeo_Fullname
description: Human readable place name extracted from news text; spellings may vary across documents. Applies to event action.

name: ActionGeo_CountryCode
description: Two character FIPS country code identifying the matched geographic place. Applies to event action.

name: ActionGeo_ADM1Code
description: First level administrative division code associated with the matched place. Applies to event action.

name: ActionGeo_ADM2Code
description: Second level administrative division code, where available. Applies to event action.

name: ActionGeo_Lat
description: Latitude of the matched geographic feature or administrative area centroid. Applies to event action.

name: ActionGeo_Long
description: Longitude of the matched geographic feature or administrative area centroid. Applies to event action.

name: ActionGeo_FeatureID
description: GNS or GNIS feature identifier, or textual geographic code, for the matched place. Applies to event action.

name: DATEADDED
description: UTC timestamp when GDELT added the event, formatted YYYYMMDDHHMMSS. Use this for fifteen minute event timing.

name: SOURCEURL
description: URL or citation of one of the earliest news reports in which GDELT detected this event.

name: ingested_at
description: UTC timestamp when the ingestion pipeline loaded this record into BigQuery. Added for this project; not in the native GDELT event feed.
